Right side has a hanging rail with garments on hangers
Unit appears handmade/basic carpentry, light wood tone, no visible brand or model markings
Floor around unit is cluttered with loose clothes, a broom, and a red object (possibly a stool or bucket)
Full structure (back, sides, legs) is partly obscured by stored clothes, limiting condition view

risks.if_unproven: priced as if rail may need reinforcement

risks.risk: Actual dimensions unknown, affecting fit and value
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure or known-size object beside the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced at lower end of typical size range for this type

risks.risk: Surface finish/paint condition not fully visible due to clutter

Close-up of the wood joints, legs, and hanging rail mounts
A photo with a tape measure showing height, width, depth
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an open wooden wardrobe/shelving unit by type, but clutter hides structural details, so it must be priced at worst-case condition until clearer photos are provided.
